Detailed inspection of tool-call-start envelopes and sidechain linkage for a specific session

root_cause.summary: The currently installed CLI binary (/usr/lib/node_modules/happy-coder/) was built from /root/happy-dev instead of /root/happy. The dev branch refactored the sessionProtocolMapper to extract shouldHideParentToolCall(name) which returns true ONLY for 'Task', not 'Agent'. This causes Agent tool-call-start envelopes to use the raw Anthropic tool_use_id (toolu_01...) as the 'call' field, instead of the CUID2 sessionSubagentForCall. Sidechain children carry the CUID2 as their 'subagent' field, creating a permanent mismatch.

evidence.dev_branch_source: /root/happy-dev/packages/happy-cli/src/claude/utils/sessionProtocolMapper.ts line 50-52: shouldHideParentToolCall returns name === 'Task' (source of the bug)

code_path_analysis.for_Task_tools: shouldHideParentToolCall('Task') returns true -> enters if block -> emits tool-call-start with call: sessionSubagentForCall (CUID2) -> CORRECT
code_path_analysis.for_Agent_tools: shouldHideParentToolCall('Agent') returns false -> falls through to generic path -> emits tool-call-start with call (raw Anthropic toolu_01...) -> WRONG, sidechain children have subagent=CUID2 which never matches

tracer_failure_chain: 2. App normalizeSessionEnvelope creates content.id = envelope.ev.call = toolu_01...
4. Sidechain children have parentUUID = envelope.subagent = CUID2
6. CUID2 passes isCuid2Like check -> children buffered as orphans
7. No parent ever arrives with that CUID2 key -> orphans remain forever
8. All 2350+ sidechain messages in the new session become permanent orphans

dev.why_old_sessions_still_work: Old sessions were created by the correct CLI binary (built from /root/happy) which used the original code with 'name === Task || name === Agent'. Both Task and Agent tool-call-start envelopes use CUID2 as call ID, matching the sidechain subagent field. The compose rebuild did not change the CLI binary - it only restarted the web container. The CLI binary was rebuilt on Mar 28 18:34 from the dev branch, which is when the bug was introduced.
dev.why_compose_rebuild_exposed_it: The compose rebuild at 21:00 restarted happy-server, causing all WebSocket connections to drop. When clients reconnected, the browser's in-memory zustand store was cleared (since compose also restarted happy-web). However, the CLI binary had already been rebuilt from the dev branch at 18:34. Sessions created AFTER 18:34 have the wrong call IDs. Sessions before 18:34 have correct call IDs. The timing coincidence with the compose rebuild masked the real trigger.

option_1_rebuild_cli.description: Rebuild CLI from /root/happy (production source) and reinstall globally
option_1_rebuild_cli.impact: Only fixes NEW sessions going forward. Existing broken sessions remain broken in DB.

option_2_fix_dev_branch.description: Fix shouldHideParentToolCall in /root/happy-dev to include Agent
option_2_fix_dev_branch.impact: If dev branch is used for builds, this prevents the bug from recurring

option_3_app_side_fallback.description: Add a fallback in the app's reducerTracer to handle the case where tool-call-start.call is not a CUID2
option_3_app_side_fallback.approach: When registering toolCallToMessageId, also check if the tool name is Agent/Task and register the sessionSubagent arg if present in the tool args
option_3_app_side_fallback.impact: Fixes display for ALL existing broken sessions without requiring message re-generation

dev.recommended_fix: Apply ALL three options: (1) Rebuild CLI from production source to fix new sessions, (2) Fix the dev branch to prevent recurrence, (3) Add app-side fallback to fix existing broken sessions that are already stored in the DB with wrong call IDs.
dev.qa_notes: The fix can be verified by: (1) Checking that new sessions after CLI rebuild show Agent tool internals, (2) Checking that old broken sessions show Agent internals after app-side fallback is deployed, (3) Running the investigation scripts against both old and new sessions to confirm toolCallToMessageId hits.
